socialMetadata.notes: Follower figures for Kayvon, Antonije, Omar, Hugues and Koen were read from their public Instagram profiles on 2026-07-28. Bobby and Joao retain the latest figures in the approved testimonial-slider source project because Instagram presented a login wall. Verified status for those two is supplied by Olli's 2026-07-28 feedback.

testimonials.name: Kayvon Jafarzadeh
testimonials.quote: I had ChatGPT, Claude, Perplexity, Notion AI, and about 10 random tools bookmarked. Still felt scattered. This made the problem obvious: I didn't need better prompts. I needed better context.

testimonials.name: Antonije Mirkovic
testimonials.quote: I've built a lot in Notion, so I was sceptical. The value wasn't the databases by themselves. It was the way everything was structured for AI to read. It's the context layer for decisions.

testimonials.name: Omar Zeineddine
testimonials.quote: I thought this was going to be another nice-looking Notion template I'd abandon in a week. It wasn't. I can ask Notion AI what matters today and it gives me an actual answer based on my business.

testimonials.name: Hugues
testimonials.quote: I've bought a stupid number of templates. Most looked great and then slowly disappeared from my life. This one stuck because it's about changing how you work with AI, not the template.

testimonials.name: Koen Salo
testimonials.quote: The biggest shift was emotional. Every morning used to start with a low-level anxiety of "where do I even start?" Now I dump everything in, organise it, and ask for a priority stack.

testimonials.name: Bobby Tandale
testimonials.quote: I can't justify hiring an assistant yet. This is the closest thing I've found to having someone help with context, planning and prep. It takes a lot of the mental sorting off my plate.

testimonials.name: João Moreira
testimonials.quote: I'm still early, so I didn't think I needed this. But the mess compounds fast. Having leads, tasks, projects and notes connected gives you a proper operating rhythm before things get out of hand.
